faq.q: How do I engage your consulting services?
faq.a: Simply fill out the contact form on my website or send me an email. I'll schedule a free initial consultation to understand your requirements, and then provide a tailored proposal with scope, timeline, and pricing.

faq.q: What industries do you work with?
faq.a: I work across a wide range of industries including financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, and logistics. The principles of good data architecture and reporting apply universally, and I adapt my approach to each industry's specific needs and regulations.

faq.q: What tools and technologies do you specialize in?
faq.a: My core specializations are Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. I'm also experienced with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, SQL Server, Python, and the broader Microsoft data stack. I choose the right tools based on your specific requirements.

Yes, I work with clients both on-site and remotely. Most of my engagements are conducted remotely using screen sharing and collaboration tools, though I'm available for on-site workshops and meetings in the Luzern/Zurich area and can travel as needed.

faq.q: What is a typical project timeline?
faq.a: Timelines vary based on project complexity. A focused Power BI dashboard project typically takes 2-4 weeks. A full Microsoft Fabric implementation can range from 1-3 months. I provide detailed timelines during our initial scoping conversation.

faq.q: Do you provide training and knowledge transfer?
faq.a: Absolutely. Knowledge transfer is a key part of every engagement. I believe in empowering your team to maintain and extend the solutions I build. I also offer dedicated training workshops as a standalone service.

faq.q: How do you ensure data security and compliance?
faq.a: Data security is a top priority. I implement row-level security, follow the principle of least privilege, and ensure all solutions comply with relevant regulations such as GDPR. I can provide a detailed data protection plan tailored to your project.

faq.q: Can you work with our existing Power BI reports?
faq.a: Yes. I frequently help organizations optimize, refactor, or extend existing Power BI deployments. Whether you need performance improvements, a redesign, or migration to a new data model, I can work with what you already have.

I offer both fixed-price project engagements and time-based consulting rates. Fixed pricing works well for clearly scoped projects, while hourly or daily rates are better for advisory work and ongoing support. I provide transparent quotes after our initial consultation.

faq.q: Do you offer ongoing support contracts?
faq.a: Yes. I offer monthly retainer packages starting at CHF 500/month that include monitoring, maintenance, bug fixes, and priority support. This ensures your data platform stays healthy and evolves with your business needs.

powerbi-migration.challenge: A mid-sized financial services firm with a fragmented reporting landscape: dozens of Excel-based reports manually maintained by different departments, inconsistent numbers, duplicated effort, delayed decisions, and no single source of truth for key financial metrics.
powerbi-migration.approach: Design and implement a centralized Power BI reporting platform backed by Azure Synapse Analytics. Consolidate the relevant source systems into a unified warehouse, build a semantic layer with standardized financial measures, and deploy a curated set of dashboards. Row-level security so each department only sees their relevant data; scheduled refreshes so the team stops preparing data by hand.

fabric-lakehouse.challenge: A growing multi-site retailer drowning in data silos: point-of-sale, inventory, e-commerce, and CRM systems all operating independently. The analytics team spends most of its time extracting and reconciling data instead of generating insights. They need a unified platform that can handle their scale and grow with the business.
fabric-lakehouse.approach: Implement a Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse that centralizes the relevant source systems into OneLake. PySpark notebooks handle the heavy ETL — ingestion, business rules, and curated analytical tables — following a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture for data quality at each stage. Power BI on Direct Lake mode delivers near real-time dashboards for store managers and executives alike.

impact.title: Faster Time-to-Insight
impact.desc: Days of data reconciliation become hours of analysis with automated pipelines and Direct Lake reporting.

impact.title: Unified Data
impact.desc: Previously siloed systems consolidate into one governed, scalable Lakehouse.

impact.title: Self-Service Analytics
impact.desc: Store managers gain direct access to their performance data without IT bottlenecks.

tech.desc: Orchestrating data movement from shop floor systems, ERP, and IoT sensors.

tech.title: Power BI
tech.desc: Operational dashboards for production managers and executive KPI summaries.

tech.title: Power Automate

automated-reporting.challenge: A manufacturer with multiple production lines, relying on manual data collection and Excel-based reporting for KPIs like OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), scrap rates, and production throughput. Reports come out weekly via a dedicated analyst — often too late to act on emerging quality issues. Management needs real-time visibility into production performance.
automated-reporting.approach: Build an end-to-end automated reporting pipeline. Azure Data Factory ingests data from shop floor systems, ERP, and IoT sensors on a schedule, transforms it, and loads it into a SQL-based warehouse with star schemas optimized for analytical queries. Power BI delivers real-time production monitoring. Power Automate fires alerts when KPIs cross thresholds so issues are addressed as they appear.

impact.title: Hours Saved Each Week
impact.desc: Weekly manual reporting effort goes away once the pipeline runs itself.

impact.title: Real-Time Monitoring
impact.desc: Production managers gain live dashboards instead of weekly static Excel reports.

impact.title: Proactive Alerts
impact.desc: Threshold alerts surface quality issues as they happen — not days later.

sections.p: Niklas Clasen Consulting ("we", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal data in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (DSG) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sub.p: When you submit the contact form, we collect your first name, last name, country, email address, and message. This data is stored in a local database and used solely to respond to your inquiry.
When you download a free resource (e.g., the Power BI Performance Checklist), we collect your name and email address to deliver the resource and for potential follow-up communication.
We use the following types of cookies:
list_html: Essential cookies: Required for the website to function (e.g., session management, CSRF protection, language preference, theme preference). These are stored in your browser's localStorage.
Analytics cookies: With your consent, we may use privacy-friendly analytics to understand site usage. No personal data is shared with third parties.
sub.p_after: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time by clearing your browser's localStorage or using the cookie consent banner that appears on your first visit.

sections.p: We process your data based on:
list_html: Consent: When you submit a form or accept analytics cookies.
Legitimate interest: To operate and improve our website.
Contract performance: To respond to inquiries about our services.

sections.p: Contact form submissions and lead data are retained for up to 24 months or until you request deletion. Cookie consent preferences are stored for 365 days.
Under the Swiss DSG and EU GDPR, you have the right to:
list: Lodge a complaint with the Swiss FDPIC or your local data protection authority
sections.p_after: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at niklas.clasen@gmail.com.

sections.p: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including CSRF protection on forms, input validation, and secure database storage.

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Data may be shared with service providers (e.g., hosting) only as necessary to operate the website, subject to appropriate data protection agreements.
If your data is transferred outside of Switzerland or the EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
We may update this policy periodically. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
